tuning_rule: maximise dev macro decision-accuracy over product categories P2-P7 (P1 is trivial, P8 is reported separately) subject to dev macro silent-error rate <= that of baseline B on dev; if infeasible minimise macro silent-error rate; ties -> larger coverage threshold, fewer typo edits, longer min length

statistics.ci: cluster bootstrap (resample clusters) 95% percentile + item-level Wilson
statistics.paired_test: cluster-level sign-flip permutation (two-sided) on per-cluster differences, Holm across the primary family; exact McNemar reported as item-level secondary
